english.meaning: an intensifier meaning to death, as in bored to death
english.note: Seen in 悶到七彩, bored to death.

exampleSentences.english: Ugh, I’d rather be alone. Ugh, I’m bored to death.
exampleSentences.traditional: 唉，我寧願得返我嚹。唉，悶到七彩啊。
